title: BIODANCE Kollagen Reinigungsöl, Gesichtsölreiniger, sanfter Make-up-Entferner ohne Poren zu verstopfen, entfernt Bleackhed und Whitehead für empfindliche Haut, fettige Haut, 199.9 ml (200ml)
bullet_points: DEEP & GENTLE CLEANSE: Effortlessly dissolves stubborn makeup, waterproof sunscreen, excess sebum, and blackheads without stripping the skin’s natural moisture. Its lightweight formula deeply cleanses while maintaining the skin’s hydration, making it ideal for daily use on all skin types, including sensitive skin.

NON-COMEDOGENIC: Formulated without PEG, synthetic oils, or pore-clogging ingredients, this cleansing oil is dermatologist-tested to be non-comedogenic. It effectively removes dirt and oil buildup while keeping pores clear and breathable, reducing the risk of breakouts and congestion.

PLANT-BASED OILS: Infused with skin-loving plant-based oils, including jojoba seed, grape seed, sunflower, and moringa seed oils, this formula mimics the skin’s natural sebum for a soothing and hydrating cleanse. These botanical oils work synergistically to break down impurities while providing essential nutrients to leave your skin feeling soft, smooth, and balanced.

QUICK EMULSIFICATION: With its advanced quick-emulsifying formula, this cleansing oil transforms into a milky texture upon contact with water, ensuring a thorough cleanse without any heavy or greasy residue. It rinses off effortlessly, leaving your skin feeling fresh, purified, and comfortable.

COLLAGEN BOOST: Unlike traditional cleansing oils, Biodance Collagen Cleansing Oil goes beyond cleansing by delivering 243Da ultra-low molecular collagen deep into the skin. This helps to replenish areas where blackheads and impurities have been removed, promoting elasticity and a smoother, more youthful-looking complexion over time.
description: PEF-free, plant-based oil removes makeup and blackheads, leaving your skin refreshed with no residue. This low-irritation cleansing oil gently cares for pores with Biodance's unique 243Da collagen.
